{"script": "#!/usr/bin/env python3
import FreeCAD
import Sketcher
from FreeCAD import Base

# Create a new document
doc = FreeCAD.newDocument("Unnamed")

# Add a sketch object
sketch = doc.addObject("Sketcher::SketchObject", "Sketch")

# Define the vertices for our shape:
# - Right vertical line from (10, 0) to (10, 20)
# - Top horizontal line from (10, 20) to (-10, 20)
# - Left vertical line from (-10, 20) to (-10, 0)
# - Semicircular arc of radius 10 centered at origin from (-10, 0) through (0, -10) to (10, 0)

# We need to add geometric entities:
# Edge 1: Line from (10, 0) to (10, 20)
# Edge 2: Line from (10, 20) to (-10, 20)
# Edge 3: Line from (-10, 20) to (-10, 0)
# Edge 4: Arc from (-10, 0) to (10, 0) passing through (0, -10), center at (0, 0), radius 10

# In FreeCAD Sketcher, we add geometry first, then constraints
# Lines are added as lines, arcs as circles/arcs

# Add the right vertical line: from (10, 0) to (10, 20)
sketch.addGeometry(Sketcher.Line(Base.Vector2d(10, 0), Base.Vector2d(10, 20)), False)

# Add the top horizontal line: from (10, 20) to (-10, 20)
sketch.addGeometry(Sketcher.Line(Base.Vector2d(10, 20), Base.Vector2d(-10, 20)), False)

# Add the left vertical line: from (-10, 20) to (-10, 0)
sketch.addGeometry(Sketcher.Line(Base.Vector2d(-10, 20), Base.Vector2d(-10, 0)), False)

# Add the semicircular arc: from (-10, 0) to (10, 0) through (0, -10)
# For an arc, we use Circle with center, start point, end point
# The arc should go from (-10, 0) to (10, 0) passing through (0, -10)
# Center is at (0, 0), radius is 10
# Since it passes through (0, -10), this is the lower semicircle
sketch.addGeometry(Sketcher.Circle(Base.Vector2d(0, 0), Base.Vector2d(-10, 0), Base.Vector2d(10, 0)), False)

print("Geometries added:")
for i, geom in enumerate(sketch.Geometry):
    print(f"  {i}: {geom.TypeId}")

doc.recompute()
print("Document recomputed successfully")"}
